p.CALIBRATION: The launcher currently requests `glm-5-turbo` for Claude's small-model traffic. Direct worker use is justified only by a live launcher/profile that actually selects it; internal Haiku routing does not prove a separately controllable worker lane.

wins.title: Task shapes it tends to win

facts.SHORT-MECHANICAL: Short, exact mechanical edits with all context compiled into the packet and a deterministic oracle.
facts.CLASSIFICATION: Bounded classification, extraction or fixture filling with a supplied schema and no design choice.
facts.CHEAP-VERIFY: Tasks whose complete result is cheaper to verify than to regenerate.

facts.NO-ARCHITECTURE: Architecture, ambiguous semantics, security posture and cross-system trade-offs remain parent-side.
facts.NO-THIN-PROMPT: Do not hand a small lane a broad goal with thin context. Exact examples, output skeleton and validation command are part of the packet.
facts.NO-TRANSFERRED-CALIBRATION: Do not inherit turn budgets, tool restrictions or quality claims from a different direct-provider or fractality profile. Observe the actual lane.
